about: Phase 25 pack v2 (flaw (c)) regression baseline, FAKE models (CI's routing.test.yaml) = the CODE path, BEFORE any rubric change. S19 and S22 FAIL here on purpose: they are the measured flaw. CI fails when a case that passed here fails, or a case without a wrong HIGH claim gains one. A fix updates this file in the same PR. 6 synthetic scenarios written for this eval: an upper bound.

source.where: sandbox replay of the CI services, 2026-10-23
